# chessgator

> Local-only chess coach. Play as White or Black against Maia with Stockfish coaching analysis.

chessgator is a free browser chess coach. You play against Maia, a human-like opponent, and a coach mascot explains ideas using Stockfish analysis that runs on your device. There are no accounts. Games stay in the browser.

## Pages

- [Play](https://chessgator.com/game): The game board — play against Maia with local Stockfish coaching
- [About](https://chessgator.com/about): What chessgator is, how a session works, and engine credits
- [FAQ](https://chessgator.com/faq): Common questions about coaching, data, first-load size, browsers, and resetting a game
- [Privacy](https://chessgator.com/privacy): Device storage, Vercel hosting logs, cookieless analytics, and contact
- [Notices](https://chessgator.com/notices): App license and Stockfish / Maia / ONNX Runtime attribution
